parent.name: Sweaters
parent.headline:
A softer layer.
A fresh feeling.
parent.description:
The familiar knit. The unexpected detail.
Find a sweater to make your own.
parent.style: Start with a layer you love.
parent.advice: A fine knit, a roomy shape or a textured stitch can change the whole outfit. Try denim for an easy day, or a flowing skirt when you want a different silhouette. Build from a piece that feels like you.
parent.detailLine: A rib. A stitch. A different feeling.
parent.heroAlt: Campaign inspiration: a woman in an oatmeal cable-knit sweater beside a pale stone wall
parent.browseTitle: Find your knit. Make it yours.
parent.campaignNote: The collection header images are illustrative campaign styling inspiration.

collections.name: Cardigan Sweaters
collections.headline:
An open layer.
An easy finish.
collections.description: A cardigan-style knit brings another possibility to your everyday wardrobe.
collections.advice: Try an open cardigan over a simple vest and jeans, or a shirt and skirt. Browse the wider Cardigans collection for more lengths and shapes.

collections.name: Cashmere Sweaters
collections.headline:
Quiet colours.
Considered layers.
collections.description: Explore the shop’s cashmere-labelled edit, from neat shapes to relaxed knits.
collections.advice: Style a fine-looking knit with tailored trousers or denim. Check the individual fibre composition and care label before choosing a cashmere or blended style.

collections.name: Cotton Sweaters
collections.headline:
Everyday layers.
Fresh possibilities.
collections.description: Discover the cotton-labelled sweater edit for easy outfit building.
collections.advice: Try a ribbed knit with a patterned skirt or a favourite pair of jeans. Check each listing for cotton content, weight and fit.

collections.name: Cropped Sweaters
collections.headline:
A shorter line.
A new balance.
collections.description: Cropped knits bring a different proportion to high-waisted skirts and trousers.
collections.advice: Pair a shorter knit with a higher rise, or layer it over a longer vest. Compare the garment length with a top you already like.

collections.name: Long Sweaters
collections.headline:
Longer layers.
Easy days.
collections.description: Discover extended hems and relaxed styling possibilities in the long sweater edit.
collections.advice: Try a long knit with slim trousers or leggings, then choose a coat with room through the body. Check the garment length for your preferred coverage.

collections.name: Off the Shoulder Sweaters
collections.headline:
A softer neckline.
A different mood.
collections.description: Explore open necklines and shoulder-baring shapes, from neat ribs to relaxed knits.
collections.advice: Keep jewellery simple and let the neckline shape the outfit. A higher-waisted skirt or trouser can balance a shorter knit.

collections.name: Oversized & Baggy Sweaters
collections.headline:
A little more room.
A little more you.
collections.description: Relaxed shapes, expressive colour and space to make the outfit your own.
collections.advice: Try a roomy sweater with a straighter skirt or slimmer trousers. Compare the shoulder and chest measurements to find the amount of ease you like.

collections.name: Spring Sweaters
collections.headline:
A lighter mood.
A fresh layer.
collections.description: Refresh your everyday wardrobe with colour, familiar shapes and easy spring styling.
collections.advice: Wear a neat knit with denim or a flowing skirt, keeping a light jacket close. Check the fabric weight to suit the weather where you are.

collections.name: Summer Sweaters
collections.headline:
Longer days.
Lighter styling.
collections.description: Explore shorter shapes and open details for your summer sweater edit.
collections.advice: Try a short knit with a linen-look skirt or relaxed trousers. Check the listed fabric and coverage before choosing a layer for warmer days.

collections.name: Tunic Sweaters
collections.headline:
A longer line.
A relaxed mood.
collections.description: Discover tunic-inspired knitwear and layered details for everyday outfits.
collections.advice: Keep your lower half simple when a longer top brings the detail. Check the garment measurements and photographs for the coverage you want.

collections.name: Turtle Neck Sweaters
collections.headline:
A higher neckline.
A clean finish.
collections.description: Discover roll-neck and high-neck knits to build a layered outfit around.
collections.advice: Try a neat high neck under an open jacket, or let a relaxed knit stand alone. Check the collar shape and fit on the individual listing.

collections.name: Winter Sweaters
collections.assignment: Editorial selection based on source photographs and product names; fit and length vary by garment.
collections.headline:
Time to layer.
Make it yours.
collections.description: An editorial selection of high necks and substantial-looking knits for colder-day styling.
collections.advice: Start with a comfortable base, add a knit and finish with a coat that leaves room to move. Check fibre content and weight to suit your climate.

collections.name: Wool & Knitted Sweaters
collections.headline:
Texture tells
its own story.
collections.description: Explore cables, ribs and expressive knit details in the wool and knitted edit.
collections.advice: Try a detailed knit with plain trousers or denim so the stitch stands out. Check each listing for the actual wool content and washing instructions.

collections.name: Fall Sweaters
collections.headline:
A change of season.
A familiar layer.
collections.description: Discover autumn styling possibilities in the fall sweater edit.
collections.advice: Pair a knit with denim or a midi skirt, then add boots and a light coat. Choose the fabric weight that feels right for your day.
